scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild js/provider.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --loader:.wasm=dataurl --sourcemap --outfile=dist/direct.js && npm run build:migration
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts --fileParallelism=false tests/storage-path.bench.browser.test.ts tests/opfs-scale.bench.browser.test.ts tests/lix-interaction.bench.browser.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:built
scripts.test:browser:built: npm run build:test-harness && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts --exclude 'tests/*.bench.browser.test.ts'
